text:
Sam: Quick, hypothetical emergency. There's a small office fire and you can only grab one editor before evacuating. Which do you rescue? React or reply with your pick. :fire:
Alex: VS Code for me. extensions and settings folder = lifesaver. :sweat_smile:
Maria: Neovim — muscle memory. Also tiny and portable. :heart_eyes:
Irene: Emacs. Sorry not sorry. It’s a way of life. :face_with_monocle:
Sam: Poll options (react with the number):
    :one: VS Code
    :two: Neovim
    :three: Emacs
    :four: Sublime
    :five: Nano
Alex: Reacted :one: — too many extensions to leave behind.
Maria: :two: — already have my dotfiles synced, so easy carry.
Irene: :three: voted. would have grabbed the whole GNU directory if I could.
deploy-bot: Reminder: office evacuation drill at 4pm today — please don't actually set anything on fire. :robot_face:
Sam: Haha noted. Also curious: any honorable mentions?
Alex: JetBrains if I were a different person.
Maria: Atom, fond memories. RIP. :disappointed_relieved:
Irene: Pico for micro emergencies.
Sam: Results so far (quick tally from reactions): 1) VS Code 2 votes, 2) Neovim 1 vote, 3) Emacs 1 vote, others 0. Close race.
Maria: We should definitely do a proper emoji poll next week.
Sam: Agreed — maybe "which dev snack to stock" next. :popcorn:
